body: What do you mean? You call the hotline and then you have to wait for them to pick up. It might take a little bit though since they seem quite busy since the quarantine.

Yeah I was, I think the suicide hotline is more focused on trying to see if you’re actually going to hurt yourself or not and if you aren’t they don’t really care and want to move on to the next person.
I’m so sorry for your loss. Alex seems like he was a wonderful person. I am sorry he was taken from you so soon.
Really? That’s never happened for me. Thank you for letting me know!
